import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',file); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def mkgrid(n, seps, marks):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for k in seps:
        g[k]=[8]*n
        for r in range(n): g[r][k]=8
    for r,c,v in marks:g[r][c]=v
    return g
